## Summary
Ferdous Wahid Fahim is a Google Ads Search Certified Specialist (Cert ID: 195327298), Conversion Tracking Engineer (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Stape.io Server-Side Tracking, Meta CAPI, CallRail, GoHighLevel), and Performance Marketer. Over 4+ years, he has supported 100+ clients and delivered 50+ projects across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, managing $15,000+ in monthly ad spend and 20+ server-side GTM deployments.

## Core Specializations
- **Google Ads & PPC Management:** High-intent Search, Performance Max (PMax), Shopping Ads, Display, 400+ Negative Keyword Architecture, Smart Bidding (Target CPA / Target ROAS) calibration, Landing Page CRO.
- **Conversion Tracking & Web Analytics:** Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Ads Enhanced Conversions (SHA-256), Server-Side Tracking via Stape.io & Google Cloud Platform, Meta Pixel & Conversions API (CAPI) with `event_id` deduplication, CallRail Dynamic Number Insertion (DNI), GoHighLevel (GHL) & Offline CRM Conversion Imports (GCLID), Looker Studio reporting.
- **Industries Served:** Home Services (HVAC, Roofing, Plumbing, Commercial & Residential Cleaning), Law Firms (Family Law, Personal Injury, Immigration), Medical & Dental Clinics, Car Rental, B2B Industrial Automation, Shopify & WooCommerce eCommerce stores.

## Verified Case Study Results
1. **Local Business Google Ads Optimization:** Reduced Cost Per Conversion (CPA) by 67% (from $83.88 down to $27.87) while increasing conversions from 2.00 to 12.93.
2. **US Home Services Lead Generation:** Generated 282 tracked conversions in 30 days (203 phone call leads + 79 web form leads) across $67.7K in managed ad spend.
3. **USA Car Rental 7-Day Sprint:** Delivered 303 conversions from 1,480 clicks (20.42% conversion rate, ~$12.90 CPA) on $3.91K ad spend in 7 days.
4. **High-Volume Google Ads Growth:** Achieved 114,000 clicks and 1,200 conversions at an average cost per conversion of $1.47 on $1.77K spend.
